import numpy as np

data = np.load('/work/fwd/r3/run.npz')
L0_mlp = data['L0_MLP']

# Check variation vs token identity
# For all-5s (input 2): all positions should write similarly  
# For all-10s (input 3): same
# Compare mean values across positions for each input
print("Mean L0_MLP write per token value:")
# Token 0 (input 4, pos 1-9)
print(f"Token 0: mean={L0_mlp[4,1:].mean(axis=0)}, std={L0_mlp[4,1:].std(axis=0)}")
# Token 5 (input 2, pos 1-9)
print(f"Token 5: mean={L0_mlp[2,1:].mean(axis=0)}, std={L0_mlp[2,1:].std(axis=0)}")
# Token 10 (input 3, pos 1-9)
print(f"Token 10: mean={L0_mlp[3,1:].mean(axis=0)}, std={L0_mlp[3,1:].std(axis=0)}")

# Check the residual stream just before L0_MLP
# It's W_E[token] + W_pos[pos] + L0_attention
# The variation within same-token inputs should tell us how much attention contributes
print("\nL0_MLP std across positions (same token) vs token-to-token variation:")
vals_0 = L0_mlp[4,1:].mean(axis=0)  # token 0
vals_5 = L0_mlp[2,1:].mean(axis=0)  # token 5
vals_10 = L0_mlp[3,1:].mean(axis=0)  # token 10
diff_0_5 = np.abs(vals_5 - vals_0)
diff_5_10 = np.abs(vals_10 - vals_5)
std_within = L0_mlp[2,1:].std(axis=0)
print(f"Token 0 to 5 difference: {diff_0_5}")
print(f"Token 5 to 10 difference: {diff_5_10}")
print(f"Std within all-5s: {std_within}")
print(f"Ratio: {diff_0_5 / (std_within + 1e-10)}")
